programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The biggest Toy in the shop is back... HEAVY METAL! Yes... Our old junk yard International Tow Truck rolls back into the garage as the freshly painted cab returns from the Hot Rot Institute. And it’s not just any paint, It’s Razzleberry from Axalta that’s so candy, you’ll want to take a bite! But there’s no time for that because Stacey jumps right in to putting a face and interior back in this old junkyard dog. The result will make you really glad that he rescued this one from the crusher! It’s recycling at it’s best... it’s GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re moving full steam ahead with the Interior of the Heavy Metal cab coming together and now’s the time to get the dash set up. We’ve got new gauges, old gauges and a bunch of empty holes where switches and knobs lived in this truck’s former life. Stacey lays out the dos and donts of getting your dash updated and a layout that makes sense before it gets installed. GearZ hits the road with a special delivery for the Hot Rod Institute for all they’ve done for us and the restoration industry. Feeling a little down about your project? Well, Stacey has a tool tech that’s sure to lift you up! All this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express returns as Stacey digs into his old ’59 ford panel truck and shows how to convert it into a one-off tool delivery truck to show off a variety of Cornwell tools. From special shelves, lighting and floor, there are even a few surprises that are tucked away inside this rolling tool cart! Moving to the cab of the vehicle, Stacey addresses some of the issues people have when setting up seats and steering, and shows some simple tricks that make a huge difference in getting your seats and steering dialed in. Then it’s on the rear to lay out the gas tank, and then finally the SR-71 gets a new beak.... from a ’59 T-bird! ...What?!?.... how is that possible? Well, ya gotta watch GEARZ to find out!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Jeep may be the single most modified vehicle out there. From winches to lights, doors and fenders, if you’ve got a Jeep, it probably has some accessories on it. But despite all that, one of the best things about a Jeep is the removable top. It also sparks one of the biggest debates... What is best: a soft top or a hard top? Stacey takes on the challenge by comparing a factory hard top with the new Bestop Trektop. The test will include everything from ease of install to styling, overall sound decibels and of course, how watertight it is. Hopefully you won’t get wet on this ride! Then it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you that rotisseries aren’t just for chickens, and how an automotive rotisserie can make life in the shop a lot easier. Finally, it’s on to the right and wrong way to use weatherstrip adhesive to hold your rubbers on. Sound risqué? It’s not... it’s just GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about square body GM trucks, because The Stunt Double is back in the shop. First, we take a look back at the this awesome ‘86 Chevy 4x4 Silverado long bed build that pays tribute to the legendary Fall Guy TV truck. From its beginnings as a well-worn farm truck, you’ll see it get an upgraded suspension, interior, drivetrain, as we make it better than I was before... better... stronger... faster... wait, that was a DIFFERENT Lee Majors TV show! After that, we walk you through the paint job and show how it is similar to the Fall Guy truck, only different.... because It’s the Stunt Double!!! No hocus pocus... no movie magic... just a tough truck being built to handle the toughest stunts... only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express is back on the block and going back together for the last time. Stacey finishes up the frame into a rolling masterpiece with the suspension and drivetrain assembled for the last time. Then the body goes back on, and the interior starts to go together. We’re talking fitting the carpet, steering column and the new dash bezel and stuffing that bezel with custom SR-71 gauges. After that, Stacey shows some tricks on how to choose the right transmission and why rechargeable power tools are giving the tried and true air tools a run for their money! It's all here and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the e85 market and flex fuel vehicles growing every day, Stacey dives into the myths and truths that surround ethanol and whether or not it’s a good choice for your vehicle. With a little help from Advanced Fuel Dynamics, Stacey installs a new fuel delivery system on a 2017 Mustang to show just how easy it is to up your performance and keep your engine safe at the same time. After that, Stacey and the crew head out west to tell the story of Bestop and how they’ve been making removable Jeep tops for decades. From rock-crawlers to the mall crawlers, Bestops unique past allows us to see what the future of the Jeep world will be. Finally, if you’re trying to decide between a stick or automatic transmission… hang out for a while as Stacey talks about converting your boring automatic to a lively manual transmission. We’ve got all this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s rare for people to reach the age of 100. It’s ever rarer for a business, but that just what Cornwell Quality Tools has done! Take a trip through the last century as Stacey tracks the development of a tool company started by a blacksmith, to the tool truck empire that stresses quality over everything else. Speaking of 100 years…trucks have been around for over a century, and for over a century, truck owners have struggled to find the best way to lift their trucks. Stacey sheds some light on picking the right kind of lift for the truck you’re driving. We’ve got all of this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: There’s nothing like a good mystery. One of our favorite GearZ mysteries is the whereabouts of Copperhead, the legendary C10 that Stacey built more than a decade ago. It seemed like the truck just disappeared. Well, it’s back! And Stacey was reunited with it at the C10 Nationals in Ft. Worth, TX. Tag along as Stacey gets a chance to get behind the wheel again and boil some tires. Back in the garage, Stacey tackles a fuel injection install on a Jeep Scrambler, then checks out the new Core Doors from Bestop. There’s a lot going on and plenty of smoke on the Texas Motor Speedway on this episode of GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: SR-71 Fins, Logo and Mystery Paint
programme.desc: As the SR71 Rapid Tool Express nears completion there are a couple of major things left on the plate before we can fire her up and get her down the road. First, every aircraft must have fins, and Stacey finally finds the fins he’s been looking for since the beginning of this build. Second, a cool logo design shows up at the shop. Third, what’s a stealthy tribute vehicle without stealthy paint? Believe it or not, Stacey’s got some paint that should keep the SR71 flying under the radar. Also, a slightly modified March Performance system will help Stacey get that much closer to putting some spark to this awesome build and stick around for plenty of other tech advice from America’s Gearhead… on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re on the road, again, as Stacey visits a truck enthusiast working on his first ground up restoration. It’s a sweet, clean, square body that’s in good enough condition that it might be on the road in a couple of months. But every build can use a little push, and GearZ On the Road does just that! After that, we dig into toolboxes. Hang out as Stacey talks with two engineers about what makes the new Cornwell Platinum boxes so tough. From rollers to welds, these might be the Ultimate box! Then the Cheetah is back in the garage, but only for a day or two before it heads out to get the body work finished and get some new color. It’s all here on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: STACEY DIGS INTO A PROJECT THAT SHOWS YOU JUST HOW MUCH FUN YOU CAN HAVE FOR ALMOST NO MONEY. BECAUSE HE’S TAKING A DERELECT 70’S ATV, STUFFING IN A JUNKYARD ENGINE, TOSSING IN SOME GOOD OL’ AMERICAN INGENINUITY AND ENDING UP WITH A REALLY COOL RIG. IT’S CHEAP! IT’S FUN! AND YOU’LL BE SURPRISED WHAT YOU LEARN ON A PROJECT LIKE THIS!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What do you get when you cross the quentessential girl's car, the Mazda Miata, with the ultimate guy's car...the Shelby Cobra? Well, Gearz is the only place to find out as Stacey blows apart an innocent Miata to get it ready for its conversion into a V8 powered, screamin' machine called the "Banshee."

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Last week he made room, this week the transplant takes place as Stacey stuffs a 400 horsepower V8 into a Mazda Miata. If you've ever wondered if it's possible to actually build a blindingly fast car on a reasonable budget...The Banshee is the project you need to see. And Gearz is the olny place to see it.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Today on Gearz, Stacey takes you for a unique spin in one of the largest 4-wheel vehicles ever built...the LARC 60. Then it's back to the shop, where he digs into frame modifications so you can be sure the foundation is strong on your project. Then finally, he throws some cool fire-power into the back of Sgt. Rock that you are going to have to see to believe. Lock and load!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This is a show for all of you restorers out there, because Stacey not only shows you how to properly drive your hotrod by flogging on a '70 Superbird, but he also shows you some tips and tricks on restoring vintage parts like exhaust manifolds and steering wheels. If you're a Gearhead, then this Gearz id for you.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It's anniversary time. The '32 Ford is 75 years old and we take a look back at what made this car so popular for so long. But that's not enought, no...Stacey shows you that the deuce is not dead...it's just getting started as he walks you through the assembly and building of a brand new, steel '32 roadster body at Brookville Roadsters.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Banshee is back on Gearz and rollin' down the final stretches as Stacey installs new suspension and brakes to help control this molten missile when he uncorks that nasty V8. Even if you are not putting a V8 in your Miata, this show is full of cool things you can do to any Miata to make it look, handle, and perform better.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Banshee gets a major facelift as Stacey transforms it from a Mazda Miata into a ...well...uh...the Banshee! that's right, the body parts fly and the cutting continues until slowly, from the mayhem, a car appears that really does look as good and run as fast as a cobra or a corvette...except the Banshee is actually affordable...And only on Gearz

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Quick...When it comes to exhaust, what is the first name that comes to your mind? If it's not Cherry Bomb, then you've missed out on a lot of years of disturbing the peace. Well, today, Stacey shows you why. Then it's a quick lesson on how to tuck your bumpers nice and tight...and a new paint product that can help you paint your car for cheap.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Today on gearz, it’s a real world, working man’s truck on the block, and Stacey shows you how to take a late model diesel pickup and make it better, stronger, and tougher than it was before…..and it’s something that can be done in the span of one weekend without breaking the bank. Proving once again that you can have a cool truck and still use it on the job.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: There is no doubt that the '32 Ford is one of the most legendary cars ever built. Today, Stacey shows that you can actually build one of these cars yourself, and that hot rodding is alive and well, by jumping into a wild, late '60's style raodster project called the Rat Roaster. If you were a street-racin' hot-footed muscle car driver back in 1968, this was the car that you didn't want to see pull up next to you.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Today on Gearz, Stacey deals with one of the most talked about issues facing hotrodding today—Cost! The nhe shows you that it is actually possible to build a steel-bodied, '32 roadster for around 20 grand. But you've got to get back to nature to do it. So, strap on your snake boots, buddy, cause the junk yard is calling.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Hey, What is the most important part of your project? Well, if you are building a classic or nostalgic car or truck, your answer will probably be the tires...and this week, Stacey visits Coker Tire, one of the most unique tire storkes in the country. Then it's off to run a leg of the great race in the legendary Honest Charlie '32 Ford. Finally, Stacey shows you some tips and techniques on how to get some exotic wood and a show-quality finish in the bed of your classic truck.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What is the most famous car movie of all time? Bullitt?… Vanishing point?... Gone in 60 seconds? Nice guesses, but in terms of influence and sheer popularity, Smokey and the Bandit stands above them all. Stacey takes a look at not only the cultural impact of Smokey and the Bandit, but also it’s most famous character… the black Trans Am. Then, it’s off for a test drive of Year One’s new Burt Reynolds Bandit edition Trans Am to see if it lives up to the true supercar status of the original. Finally, Stacey takes a look and shows you how to use, one of the most mysterious and versatile metal working tools out there… the English Wheel

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The “Rat Roaster” returns and Stacey finally reveals the kind of power plant that would have made this wild deuce roadster the fastest car in the valley in 1968. And if dual carbs, a blower and about 600 horsepower don’t get you going... maybe the fact that he’s stuffing a 5-speed manual transmission behind it, will! Then, Stacey digs into the Parts Bin to take a look at some of coolest products on the market to help you build your own special ride.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey not only brings the “Rat Roaster” ‘32 back in the shop, but he also takes it under the knife as he creates a very unique Dr Jekyll and Mr. Hyde style exhaust system and does some custom modifications to the frame to hide it all from the casual on-looker. If you are interested in taking your project and building it into something truly unique by thinking outside the box… this show will definitely encourage you to do that. Then, Stacey digs into some tips and tricks on how to set your vehicle up for storage for those times when your classic car or hot rod is going to be sitting for awhile unused.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: In the world of hot rodding, when gear heads gather around and start discussing their projects, invariably the conversation drifts into speculation of what the smallest thing is that you can successfully put a V8 engine in. Stacey pretty much puts an end to that speculation by building a V8 powered Barstool! It’s part go-cart… part garden tractor… part insane... and ALL hot rod, which of course is what Gearz is all about! If you like WILD… then you don’t want to miss this show! Then, Stacey dives into some Muffler Tech to show you what kind of mufflers there are on the market, and give you some tips that might help you make the right decision when the time comes to stick some cool mufflers on your machine.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When it comes to classic hot-rod components, nothing gets people going like a multi-carb setup... the Tri-power. Long admired for their stellar performance and macho attitude, the tri-power has become a hard thing to find. So why find one? Why not build your own? Stacey walks you through the process of building your own tri-power out of old derelict parts. After that, he pulls out the big Mopar guns and shows what it takes to put together a six-pack. Then, Stacey gets down and dirty and shows you how to build some simple, ultra strong axle dollies by using some old scrap metal like the kind laying around your garage. Who said gearheads aren’t into recycling?

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Banshee is back from paint and we're ready to answer the question… does it still look like a ’95 Miata? Has Stacey shown you how to create a completely different monster? Well, all we can say is the proof is in the paint and you are not going to believe how complete and affordable this transformation really is! Then, Stacey digs into the age-old question: Is it better to restore a car original, or modify it? The answer is up to you as he features a really clean ’68 Plymouth GTX… with some not-so-subtle modifications.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey pulls out the tools and starts working metal as he dives into the subject of what to do when your floors are gone… I mean literally gone…nothing there! It’s not as big of a problem as you may think! Stacey rolls in the Rat Roaster and shows you how to create solid metal floors from nothing. This show is loaded with tools and tech that will help you build anything from a small patch panel to a complete floor. While he’s at it, Stacey also covers seat selection and placement so you have a place to plant your seat when you get ready to roll down the street.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine Armor All, Tony Stewart and Stacey David with an iconic vehicle like the Corvette? You get a really cool car called “Ol’ Smoke” and some lucky viewer is going to own it! That’s right, Stacey takes a brand-new ‘Vette' and shows you how to create your own 180+ MPH supercar for a fraction of the cost, using some aftermarket parts. How is that possible?... turbos baby!... and on this show Stacey shows you how to slap a pair of ‘em on the Corvette to run the horsepower numbers to over 600! If you have ever wondered about turbo charging an if it’s right for your vehicle, this is a show you definitely want to see.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Ol' Smoke Corvette Brakes Wheels Tires
programme.desc: Ol’ Smoke is back as Stacey finishes up the transformation of a brand-new ’08 Corvette, into a full-on super car capable of running with any Ferrari, Porsche, or Lamborghini. It’s a brake upgrade, along with wheels and tires and some custom airbrushing, to not only make the car even more unique, but to also get it ready for it’s new owner to enjoy. Then, Stacey takes Ol’ Smoke out and puts it through the paces showing once again that you can not only have fun building something cool, but also having just as much fun driving it when you are done. No doubt about it, somebody is going to get a special car when Armor All gives Ol’ Smoke away.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What is the nastiest project that everyone has to do eventually? That’s right… replacing old, worn out, nasty carpeting. Stacey rolls the Banshee back in the shop and shows you how to bring a very tired interior back to life with some tips and tricks that will help in replacing those old, worn out threads with some new ones. While we are on the subject of interiors, Stacey also digs into one of the best kept secrets in auto restoration… painting a dash and door panels. If you would like to make your dash and door panels look like new again in just a few hours… for very little money… and not have the paint flake off in a few weeks in big chunks, then this is the show you have to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes a look at one of the first aftermarket parts that became available to the public back in the day: the performance air filter… and man does it have an interesting story! From the lowly beginnings of fragile paper elements... to the massive, top secret facilities of industry powers like K&N, the air filter has a heritage that was born and bred on the race track! Then, Stacey digs into one of the neatest tools you’ll ever see and one that every metal worker should own… the Power Hammer. If you are interested in shaping metal and building your own panels, then you need to see this in action.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey borrows an ‘07 Jeep JK from a family and jumpstarts their project with the sole purpose of taking it to the next level. However, the real challenge is to build something the whole family will like and still be able to use on the street or off-road. If you’ve ever sat and stared at your project and tried to figure out what the heck to do next or what is the best thing to spend your time and money on… this show is the one to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey puts the finishing touches on the ’07 Jeep Wrangler with off-road bumpers, body armor, and lights... and builds a very capable off-road rig that is still civil enough to be driven every day. However, just before the Rhea family takes possession of their “new” Jeep, Stacey springs a little surprise on them… He enlists them to help him squeeze a little more performance and gas mileage out of the vehicle, just to prove that anybody can do it! On go the performance air intake, computer upgrades, synthetic oil, and even some slick new seat covers. If you have been reluctant to modify your vehicle because you didn’t think you had the ability…Think again! This show proves that anybody can be a gearhead and make their vehicle better in some way. So now you have no excuse to not be working on something!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes a well worn, ’73 Chevy pickup that was left for dead in the late 80’s, and starts bringing it back to life by upgrading the suspension and brakes. Not only is this a project that most anybody can do, but it is the start of a three-part series of the major steps that are involved in rebuilding a vehicle. With the way the economy is and the price of new vehicles today, this show demonstrates that there is a better option than buying something new…. bust your own knuckles and build it yourself! Then Stacey sits down with off-road racing legend Ivan Stewart to find out what makes him “the Ironman”.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey jumps back into the “KnuckleBuster” project, and deals with an area we can all relate to… a sick engine and transmission. But instead of getting rid of that old worn out vehicle, you can bring it back to life by stuffing in a new engine and transmission; Stacey walks you through the steps to show you just how easy this can be. But, you must be willing to bust your knuckles some and get your hands a little dirty! After that, Stacey puts on the gloves and shows you how to perform a little surgery on a tired rear-end to get the traction that only a locker can supply. Make sure to turn your head and cough!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everybody knows that the area most prone to wear and tear on your vehicle is the interior. Well, that’s OK because today Stacey shows you how to dig into one and bring it back to life without spending a fortune. Whether you just need carpet, door panels, or a complete overhaul, this is something you can do with your own two hands if you are not afraid to get dirty. Then, it’s on to the place you spend most of your time… the seat! As Stacey goes through the steps of reupholstering your old rag-tag seat, you’ll see it can be made as good as new. If you are tired of driving around with an old ratty interior and don’t know what to do, this episode of GEARZ is for you!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If there is one thing that every gearhead dreams of doing, it’s getting their car out on the open road and opening it up to see how fast it will go. Of course, there are a few things like speed limits, tickets, and jail time that keep people from doing this sort of thing. But, wouldn’t it be great if it was possible to do it just once? Well it is... and today Stacey shows you where as we showcase the last real outlaw race in the country… the Silver State Classic road race. If you have a car, and the desire to drive it fast, then there is 90 miles of wide open, two-lane highway in Nevada calling your name! Then it’s back to the GEARZ shop where Stacey addresses one of the most versatile tools you can have in your shop… the MIG welder.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you’ve been around cars and trucks very long, you know that vintage, nostalgia, and rat rods are very popular. The question is, how do you make a nostalgia-style car with leaf springs hook up like a modern drag car but not lose the vintage look? Simple… you install a ladder bar system! But how do you keep the leaf springs from binding you ask? Ah... there is a special way to do it, and if you want to find out what it is …you need to catch this episode of GEARZ. Then it’s out on the road to test it out as Stacey shows you just how much fun you can have with a nostalgia-style vehicle. Would somebody please bail him out of jail?!?

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: One of the most frustrating things that can happen when you are building a project is finding out the parts you need are no longer available. This can usually bring the project to a screeching halt! But all is not lost because there is another option and Stacey walks you through the ins and outs of hunting for those elusive parts in a salvage yard. After that, it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you how to restore those old, rag-tag parts that you find. It’s auto recycling at its best, and with today’s economy, it’s also a smart thing to do!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Rat Roaster is back!... and this wild little ’32 Roadster gets even wilder as Stacey starts adding some cool details to lock it into the Hot Rod and Rock and Roll culture of 1969. A cool microphone shifter with a touch of James Bond, a bass drum kick pedal, bobbed fenders and a wild custom Gibson guitar to go with the car are just part of it. There is also a special appearance by legendary bass player, Billy Cox, as he talks about playing Woodstock with Jimi Hendrix. After that, Stacey gives you the low-down on the plasma cutter and why you need one. If you like shows that are laced with equal amounts of cool and history, then this episode of GEARZ is one you HAVE to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Some of the biggest news to come down the automotive pipeline in a long time is the fact that Dodge is making the Challenger again. But how does it stack up against the legendary Challengers of old? Well, Stacey decides to find out! First, by “grabbing” a Challenger in a most unorthodox way and then comparing it head-to-head with a 70’ 440 six-pack car. But that’s not all… Then Stacey decides to take the new car beyond the legend by sticking on a supercharger and really blowing the doors off of the competition! If you are a Mopar nut, or have just wondered what all the fuss was about concerning the new Challenger…this is one show you’ve got to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the price of gas going up, down, and all over the place, people are becoming more and more concerned about fuel economy, and GEARZ is asked time and time again what products we recommend that really give you better economy and performance. Well, ask no more…because Stacey not only addresses that question, but also goes through the top 6 upgrades that ANYBODY can do to a vehicle! That’s right; these are inexpensive AND easy to do! After that, Stacey takes on the subject of alternative fuels by demonstrating that you can actually make a diesel engine run, and run well, on old used cooking oil! Now there is yet another reason to eat French fries! So pass the ketchup and put the hammer down!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Every once in a while, there comes a point in your project where there are no parts available to help you, and your only choice is to make something yourself… but how do you do that? Stacey walks you through the steps of how to lay out an engine swap, and how to hand fabricate motor mounts, so you can stick an engine into a vehicle that it was never intended to go into. It’s hard-core, down and dirty how-to, but somebody has to do it… and it needs to be YOU. The good news is, with Stacey walking you through the process and showing you how to solve problems, it CAN be you! Now you just need to get out in the garage and start working!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everybody knows that the engine is a central key component to ANY Hot Rod project. But is a V8 the only way to go? NO WAY! Stacey takes a vintage straight six engine that has been sleeping in a crate for almost 40 years and he puts on the right pieces. He shows you why the straight six was a force to be reckoned with in the early days of hot rodding. After that, Stacey jumps into the tips and tricks of how to paint your own true Kandy paint job. If you are into vintage Hot Rods, Kandy paint, and multi-carbs… you don’t need to go on a diet… you just need to watch GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The “KnuckleBuster” is back on GearZ, and Stacey is putting the final touches on this ’73 Chevy pickup. After a quick look at the new paint slathered on its flanks, Stacey gives the truck a face lift with grille, bumpers, and all that other cool trim stuff. Then it’s on to the bed where he lays in some oak to give the former “beater” some class and style. Finally, it’s underneath to stick in a new exhaust system to keep the bad gas blowing out the back. If you have ever wondered if you could really build something cool yourself… all you have to do is check out the finished “KnuckleBuster” and be willing to bust YOUR own knuckles… the rest will take care of itself!

programme.sub-title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E07 - Hawaii
programme.desc: In this episode, we pursue the spirit of ambition while discovering Hawaii's immortal culture! From walking the hallowed grounds of Hilo Coffee Mill to witnessing the reinvention of traditions at Old Lahaina Luau- this episode represents the best of what is to be expected while traveling wide-eyed through paradise!

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer
programme.sub-title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E08 - The Island Hawaii
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit The Island of Hawaii better known as “The Big Island.” Here, we explore the history and geography of the islands, learn how to Hula Dance, visit a tranquil secluded retreat, learn the art of lei-making, and have some sea and land adventures!

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S08 E05 Christmas Special: 96 Hours in Jordan
programme.desc: Comedian and Author David Baddiel joins Richard Ayoade for a supersized seasonal minibreak in Jordan. Over four frenetic days they visit world-class wonders, jaw-dropping deserts and over-salted seas, follow in the footsteps of Prophets and legends, and criss-cross the country by road, rail, rotor and hoof, picking up some special Christmas presents along the way.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E09 - Joshua Tree NB
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, our journey began with Gabi, our knowledgeable astrology expert, who gracefully guided us through the mesmerizing wonders of the full moon, mercury retrogrades, and the celestial constellations. We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. Marilia experienced profound rejuvenation as her body, mind, and soul were harmonized by the ethereal vibrations of diverse instruments.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E10 - L.A. NB
programme.desc: In the LA episode, our journey began with an awe-inspiring hike alongside the wolves. Wolf Connection revealed the magical nature of these animals and sparked a conversation about the connection between women and wolves. We then delved into Ayurveda, learning from Jay about the presence of nature in our bodies and how to maintain balance. Karla, an Ayurvedic chef, treated us to a delightful meal while emphasizing the importance of food for our well-being. Marilia fearlessly took a leap from an airplane, showing us how extreme sports can free us from fear. Lastly, Tracy showcased her life and passion for WCMX at the skate park, highlighting the joy found in pursuing our passions.

programme.title: Chasing The Sun
programme.sub-title: Chasing The Sun S01 E11 - Peru
programme.desc: Chasing the Sun, explores Peru's vibrant culture, bustling cities, and artistic spirit. From Lima's rich history and motor taxis to Barranco's music scene, discover inspiring stories of resilience, creativity, and the beauty of this remarkable country.

programme.title: Chasing The Sun
programme.sub-title: Chasing The Sun S01 E12 - Peru
programme.desc: Chasing the Sun, explores Peru's vibrant surf culture and community spirit. From Sofia Mulanovich's surf program to Diego's workshops for underprivileged kids, discover inspiring stories of resilience, environmental efforts, and the beauty of Peru.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S02 E07 - Mongolia - Meals And Wheels
programme.desc: The guys stay with the Tsatsaan Reindeer tribe for a couple more days before the long trek back to Ulaan Bator. Scott and Justin stop along the way at a complete strangers ger (traditional Mongolian tent) where the three are invited in for fermented yaks-milk and some mix of goat-organ soup. Craving adventure of a different variety, they rent ATV’s and drive freely into the Gobi desert. Camping at night, and driving by day, the trio discover the ultimate idea of freedom, before running into various trouble on the road.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Iceland’s raw nature, good hearted people and vast open spaces encourage Scott and Justin to brave the elements. From Reykajavik the guys rent a 4x4 truck and hit the open roads, no matter what the conditions. They encounter a family while sheep herding, and join in to help on their way to find adventure in the ice and glaciers . Active volcanoes, ice climbing and squeezing into an underground lava tube hint towards some of the personal strength needed to continue their world adventures.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We start our trip in the coasts of Jamaica, where we can splash in the waves and sunbathe on the best beaches, we'll go from "Montego Bay" to "Ocho Rios" and before we go to the next destination we will delight in "The Bay of Boston" , which is home of the delicious Marinated Chicken, Jamaican style or "Jerk" Chicken. Then we went to the city known as "Beauty on water", in Stockholm, Sweden. We will visit its museums, medieval Castles and the largest and most imposing palace where royalty still lives: the Stockholm Royal Palace. A place full of history. Finally, we'll finish our adventure with a chilling search in Patagonia, Argentina; to know this immense land full of wonders, in which we will climb a large mass of ice in Los Glaciares Park to know the most spectacular of them, the Perito Moreno Glacier.

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: On this episode, we are going on a trip around the world. First, well be visiting China and climbing the Great Wall, which is considered as one of the most impressive architectural edifications in history. It stretches 5,500 miles long and in 2007, the Great Wall was chosen to be one of the new 7 Wonders of the World. During this episode, well go to the local market, try amazing local foods and finally see face to face intriguing soldiers of terracotta, at the local exhibition where there are carriages and horses over 2000 years old. Then get ready, its time to explore the magnificent Grand Canyon... Well hike, sail the rapids, camp under the stars; and climb a bridge to watch the canyon on a transparent walkway. To finish off this trip well go to India, play a little Cricket, walk through the majestic Taj Mahal, and visit the Holi festival, a party of color and joy like no other.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: In this episode we will travel to Paris and visit the Louvre, one of the most important museums in the world, we will cross the Seine River in an incredible journey through its waters and under its bridges in the Batobus, and finally we will climb to the top of the most emblematic building of Paris: the Eiffel Tower. Then we will go to a true natural paradise, the exotic islands of Hawaii, where we will discover the famous Hawaiian volcanoes, and travel in time to the beginning of the Second World War when visiting the Pearl Harbor Museum. To round things up we will learn why Hawaii is the favorite destination for the surfers and for lovers of water sports of all kinds. As if all that were not enough, we will visit Rio de Janeiro in Brazil, where we will enjoy the famous Beaches of Ipanema and Copacabana, and ascend to the top of Corcovado Hill to embrace the "Christ the Redeemer", and top it all off we will experience the biggest party of all Latin America:" The Carnival of Rio ".

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We will travel to Cairo and rent a camel to visit the ancient and ancient famous, we will see the Pyramids, one of the seven wonders of the ancient world and we will travel to the other side of the world to Buenos Aires; where we will visit San Telmo, one of the oldest and most picturesque neighborhoods of the city. From there we will depart to Bora Bora, one of the French Polynesian islands and we will finish this unforgettable trip visiting some beaches with crystalline waters, unique in the world.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: In this episode we will travel to New York, to see its most famous skyscrapers, we'll go on an incredibly fun bike ride through Manhattan, there we will have a test of New Yorks gastronomy. And before we say goodbye to this location well visit the Statue of Liberty. Then we will visit the city of Pamplona, in Spain, we'll do a walking tour of its streets, play a little Vasque ball, we'll see the Basilica of San Ignacio de Loyola and attend the San Fermin festivities, where we will be running with the bulls. Finally, we returned to the tropical latitudes in Ecuador, where we visited the Galapagos Islands. We will have close encounters with the Galapagos, and other fauna and vegetation unique to this place. At the Charles Darwin Research Station they will explain everything there is to know about giant tortoises and in Puerto Ayora we will say our goodbyes to South America on Santa Cruz Island.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We'll start our adventure with a tour of Brussels, we will visit the Stoclet Palace, declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. Then we'll go to the Atomium, an immense structure that represents an iron crystal, it has a restaurant in its highest sphere, from there you can see Laeken Park's 395 hectares. We'll visit the main square called "Grand Place", also declared a World Heritage Site in 1988. In the magical city of Bruges. Then, we will go to the Atacama Desert in Chile, in the Antofagasta region. We will visit the Valley of the Moon and the National Reserve of Flamingos. This desert is considered the best place on earth to observe the heavens and study astronomy, while In the Tatio geysers fields where there are thermal springs and fumaroles. And finally we'll arrive in Milan, Italy to see Piazza del Duomo,in downtown Milan, where you will not miss the best presentation of Italian Opera at the "Teatro alla Scala". Finally, we will end our adventure with a tour through the beautiful Navigli in Milan.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We'll start our trip in the exotic New Zealand, we'll visit its impressive national parks and some incredible caves! There we'll explore the Waitomo Caves, which are around two million years old and the Glowworm Caves with their luminous worms. We will observe New Zealand's unique birds and we will finish our tour boarding the Go Orange cruise to navigate between the Fjords. Then, we'll go to San Francisco in the United States, to cross one of its most emblematic symbols: the Golden Gate Bridge, walk Fishermans Wharf to see fun attractions such as the Ripley Museum and the Madame Tussaud's wax museum and Pier 39 to taste all kinds of fresh seafood, including a final stop on Alcatraz Island. We'll finish our adventure in the Dominican Republic where we will see the "Catedral Primada" or the First Cathedral of America, it was the first church built in the New World. We will walk through the Colonial Zone which was declared by UNESCO in 1990 as World Cultural Heritage and we'll taste the incredible local gastronomy of this Caribbean country. Before leaving we live the amazing experience of swimming with dolphins in Punta Cana.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We'll tour the exotic city of Istanbul in Turkey, formerly known as Constantinople. It is the most populated city in Turkey and occasionally confused as its capital as it is Turkey's historical, economic and cultural center of the country. We'll sail through the Bosphorus, the river that separates its European part from its Asian part. Our journey through Istanbul continues through the Blue Mosque, built between 1609 and 1616. A unique experience is to visit the Grand with more than 50 streets where thousands of tourists look for the best prices every day. Then, we will visit Dubai, a real and exciting treasure that awaits us on the coast of the Persian Gulf. Located in the Arabian desert, its culture reflects a clear Islamic influence that can be seen in its clothing, social traditions, art and literature. Being its luxurious architecture what causes greater contrast, Maybe thats why Dubai is the city with the most avant-garde architecture in the world and it has already become the third city with the highest number of skyscrapers.Finally, we will travel to Las Vegas, surrounded by large mountains and in the middle of the Mojave Desert, in Nevada. Today you will discover that Las Vegas is much more than luck, lights and imitators of Elvis Presley. There are a number of different experiences and equally huge ... as is usually the case in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: In this episode we will to travel to Sydney, the most populated city in Australia and Oceania with almost 5 million inhabitants! This city is a combination of beaches for surfing and a magnificent natural harbor. Sydney has countless natural attractions, such as beautiful public gardens, islands in the bay and unspoiled coasts. A metropolis with a variety of places to visit such as the Opera House, the Tower Eye and the "Sydney Harbor Bridge" over Sydney Bay. In the next adventure, we crossed several continents to reach the Isthmus of Panama; The geographical scenario of the Panama Canal,which offers the world a wide platform of maritime, commercial, real estate and financial services, including the Colon Free Zone, which is the largest free zone in the continent and the second in the world. You will also visit the Casco Viejo, the colonial side of town. This week the adventure concludes in Tokyo, Japan. This city and its adjacencies take a quarter of the Japanese population, 12 million souls in one place, which makes it a chaotic and modest area at the same time, where the mere fact of seeing people on the street is a tourist attraction. You will visit the Tsukiji Market, the Ueno District, and the Tokyo Tower, a famous communications tower located in the center of the capital whose design was based on the well-known Eiffel Tower in Paris.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: Today's adventure begins in Machu Picchu, to learn about the fascinating culture of the Incas. You will cross amazing roads, you will meet the ruins and you will be able to see a place as amazing as The Citadel. We will see the street of Hatun Rumiyuq, where once was the palace of Inca Roca and all the incredible work in stone for which Cuzco is known. Our second destination will take you to Saint Petersburg, the historic Russian capital. We will visit the Hermitage Museum to see part of its immense collection, the largest in the world with almost three million works of art! In addition, you can enjoy the most delicious dishes of Russian food: the "Kotlety" which are small, fried meatballs made of ground meat. Cancun is the final destination of this episode. We'll immerse ourselves in both: its waters and its history, visiting some of its emblematic beaches and go to Tulum, a very interesting archaeological site.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We will start in Asia to discover the attractive and enigmatic Vietnam from a unique perspective while riding a bicycle and then tour the tunnels of war. We will get to know the city of Ho Chi Minh where the cultural and economic life that defines all of Vietnam is established. During our tour, you will appreciate the city's French colonial architecture and its endless caravans of motorcycles that circulate all over. Then we will go to London, on a tour of the famous red buses that first circulate in London since 1956. After a visit to the Big Bent, we'll go enjoy a rich portion of fish-and-chips, the traditional London street-food, in a city full of multiple possibilities. Our trip finishes in Los Angeles, the city where everything you can imagine becomes reality thanks to all the talent and art of Hollywood. We will tour the Hollywood Walk of Fame, a sidewalk along Hollywood Boulevard and Vine Street. In its floor there are located more than 2000 stars with the names of different celebrities.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: This time in "The World is Yours" will take you to a very peculiar island: Madagascar! There we will spend time in the company of the strangest creations of Nature. Caverns, beaches, reefs and exuberant forests where the most exotic fauna and flora of the planet coexist, will be the destination of this wonderful journey in which you will be received by its friendly inhabitants and their zest for life! Now, if what you are looking for is to share with friends and feel like at home, nothing like New Orleans' southern hospitality. Get ready because the food and the music are not the only charms of this moving city. History, customs and colorful festivals await you in the streets of this picturesque place. This tour ends with a trip to the past, to the age of castles and cathedrals at Edinburg! Where youll feel as the star of stories of knights in armor, you will listen to the stories of the soldiers who participated in the siege of the castle and visit the Cathedral of St. Egidio to enjoy its architecture with original stained-glass windows of the XXIV century its really worth knowing!

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We will travel to Santorini, to build castles of red sand, or black sand, on the beach of Akrotiri. We will see how much fun Santorini offers us, along its mountain range, with its emblematic towns, although hidden on the side of a volcanic mountain, are villages that are full of activity at any time of the day. We will make a stop for tea in Hong Kong and learn about its history. With one of the largest and most iconic horizons in the world, our next destination will make you believe that the past and the present merge in perfect harmony. If you want to try something more traditional of classical Chinese cuisine, enjoy a "Dim sum", a custom similar to British "tea time". "Dim sum" literally means drinking tea. On the last leg of this trip we will explore Mexico City searching for the remains of civilizations that no longer exist The Aztec Empire. Perhaps, we will even find evidence of some that many believe that never existed. According to what is known about them, it was a civilization quite advanced and capable of supporting hundreds of thousands of people.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We start our trip in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, with more than a thousand windmills and a serious expertise in cheese-making. There is a lot of ground to cover in this visit to Holland, the best of all is that no matter where you look, the landscape will be absolutely spectacular! Holland is known for its beautiful European countryside, with modest farmhouses that give the visitor the feeling of traveling through time. We will visit the Van Gogh Museum, which is the second most visited museum in the Netherlands and receives around 2 million people annually. To travel the ancient streets of Rome, we'll change the tourist bus for a scooter, we'll tread the same arena where gladiators fought, and we will take a picture with a 86-foot fountain in the background. Finally, we will find the perfect mind-body balance with a visit to Laos, a Southeast Asian country that seems to have remained hundreds of years in the past. One of the best tourist destinations that our planet can offer and has been a well-kept secret until very recently. We will finish our trip at the "Kuang Si" Falls with its main attraction, a waterfall of three levels.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We begin our trip in Arizona, the sixth largest state in the U.S.A., there we will get as close as possible to space while visiting the Pima Air & Space Museum. We will also visit the Petrified Forest National Park and the incredible Grand Canyon. To top it off we will see the beauties offered by the Navajo Nation. Then we will cross the ocean to the happiest place on earth: Norway! To enjoy this beautiful countryside landscape and visit Preikestolen, a city full of smiling people. We will go to Otter Island, one of the newest and most adorable attractions in this country. And we will discover the Botanical Gardens of Oslo and the ports of Norway where we will delight with its delicious gastronomy. To finish our trip in Australia, specifically at Shell Beach. There is a lot to do in this place, like taking a walk to the shore of a beautiful beach covered with millions of shells and finally, we will feed the dolphins in Monkey Mia, a refuge where bottlenose dolphins have made their home during the last 50 years.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 40: Doble compromiso, celos y burla.
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo llega a la casa de los Malav justo despu s que Walter hizo la petici n de mano de Daniela y Armando se burla de l y todos se asombran cuando a continuaci n llega In s invitada por Robert quien anuncia tambi n su compromiso con ella. Michelle se molesta cuando Diego Andr s se niega a mostrar el medall n a Flavia y Marisela oye cuando ste dice que lo entreg a las autoridades para saber que no fue robado. Daniela le reclama a Robert por haber llevado a In s a la casa y ste no le hace caso. Armando con sus comentarios trata de molestar a In s pero ella le hace ver que aceptar que Robert se retraiga de su petici n de matrimonio si as lo desea y Berta se burla de todos los presentes.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Es el entierro de Salvatore. Inmaculada ve a Salom n en el funeral y se desmaya. Inmaculada le cuenta a Abril esto, y ella le dice que es imposible, porque Salom n Grun, est preso. Sof a enfrenta a su padre Vespasiano y no puede creer que haya sido capaz de hacerle tanto da o a Pelusa. Sof a est dolida triste y decepcionada. Para ella su padre, era un hombre perfecto, honesto, sincero, y no puede creer, que result ser un pat n, un sinverg enza y un mujeriego. Sof a le dice a Vespasiano, que Josu jam s va a perdonarle lo que hizo, porque Josu , fue quien sac a Pelusa de la condena en la que l la meti , s lo para salvar su reputaci n. Sof a le dice que ella no le va a decir nada a Josu .

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 52: El ruego de B rbara y el secreto de Charo
programme.desc: B rbara busca a Manuel en el club de box, le jura que l es el hombre que ella ama, que nunca pas nada con Tommy y que el dinero y los autos lujosos ya no son importantes para ella, pues lo nico que quiere es que l la perdone, sin embargo Manuel sigue muy dolido y no la perdona. - Mientras Josefina le dice a Sebasti n que no cree nada de lo que le dijo Sara sobre la locura de Clara, vemos a Charo algo desquiciada mentalmente, vestida y peinada como Socorro y hablando ante un espejo como si se tratara de la propia Coc . Isabel presencia este cuadro y Charo la amenaza con decirle a Socorro que el padre del hijo que espera es Julio C sar si le cuenta a su amiga algo de lo que acab de ver.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 52: Abuso de poder y silencio forzado
programme.desc: Marisela es victima del abuso de poder de Nancy tras intentar interrogar a Gabriela en cuanto a su relaci n con Ricardo. Gabriela en vista de la falta de comunicaci n confunde la situaci n de Marisela con un gesto de antipat a. Gabriela se deja sorprender por el regreso de Fernando a su casa. Abril sinti ndose interesada en indagar mas acerca de la vida de Gavil n intenta obtener informaci n por medio del muchacho quien se muestra renuente al sentirse supuestamente acosado por ella. Marisela se ve obligada a mantener silencio ante los maltratos y las ofensas de Nancy esperando as mantener su trabajo dentro de la cl nica a pesar de ser degradada

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 95: Sospechas, Celos y Secretos Familiares Revelados
programme.desc: Dileidi trata de despedirse de Lu s Fernando con un beso en la mejilla pero el no se resiste y voltea un poco la cara para que sea en la boca; Dileidi le reclama. En casa de Gladis, Gabito la invita a salir, pero Gladis se niega, Dileidi llega a la casa y Aureliano le asoma un peque o reclamo pero Dileidi tambi n se molesta y le recuerda que ellos son amigos. Gladis le pregunta qui n la llevo hasta la casa y Dileidi miente. Por otro lado Santiago flirtrea con Egle en su casa y llega Lu s Fernando y los encuentra muy contento preguntando cual es el chiste; ellos disimulan pero los interrumpe Mar a Gracia d ndole la bienvenida a Lu s Fernando y llev ndoselo para el cuarto. Jerson que se encuentra en la cocina con Gladis, le comenta que se siente muy bien por el trabajo de vigilante que ahora tiene, y le comenta que le gustar a que su pap lo viera porque puede sentirse orgulloso de el vi ndolo vestido de uniforme; Gladis se enoja por ese comentario porque Jerson sabe que su pap los abandono cuando supo que ella estaba embarazada. Jerson insiste y le pregunta si sabe en donde localizarlo, Gladis lo niega. Aristigueta se encuentra reunido con Marco Aurelio discutiendo el proyecto de la urbanizaci n y son interrumpidos por una llamada que le hicieron a Aristigueta sobre el pedido de flores. Marco Aurelio se asombra por la hora de ese pedido pero Aristigueta le responde que es el amor. La Nena est muy nerviosa porque no sabe quien est tocando el timbre porque puede ser Aristigueta o Doroteo. Cuando abre se da cuenta que es Doroteo y lo recibe muy bien. La Nena nota que Doroteo est extra o y este le reclama sobre el supuesto mercadito que le regalaron las amigas, porque Jerson le cont a Doroteo que ese mercadito se lo llevaron en un carrazo y un chofer hasta su casa, y el lo nico que quiere saber si es verdad que ella tiene una conquista millonaria. La Nena se muestra molesta por ese reclamo y porque la esta tildando de mentirosa y discuten, pero en ese momento el timbre suena y es una persona que por cierto le pide ayuda a Doroteo para poder llevar a la casa muchos ramos de flores. Cuando el mensajero se va de la casa Doroteo le reclama por todas flores y se va muy molesto de la casa. La Nena trata de detenerlo pero sin xito. Tatiana llega en ese momento y se muestra muy alegre por todos esos ramos. Gabito y Aureliano llegan a la bodega muy mal por el rechazo que obtuvieron tanto de Gladis como de Dileidi respectivamente; All son recibidos por Remedio con una gran comida y mucho cari o. Dileidi que esta con Yeniluz en su cuarto le propone que trabaje con ella en la empresa, y le cuenta adem s que qui n la llevo para su casa fue Lu s Fernando. Mientras que en casa de Egle, Lu s Fernando le est contando todo lo que le pasa con Dileidi, pero Santiago no le esta poniendo atenci n alguna, ya que lo que est pendiente es de Egle que est en el sofa y viceversa, Egle hace que est leyendo pero lo que est es pendiente de Santiago. Egle se despide porque supuestamente se va a dormir y Santiago tambi n lo hace muy apresuradamente dejando a Lu s Fernando sin poder contar todo lo sucedido. R mulo dormido sue a con varias escena y en todas ellas aparecen dici ndolo que no lo saben o puede ser. R mulo se despierta exaltado y piensa que todo est clarisimo; Egle lo traicion , se esta acostando con otro y par ndose y llegando a la casa de Egle despertando a todos. R mulo le reclama a Egle y ella est muy confusa porque no sabe de lo que le est hablando el. R mulo sigue habl ndole y le dice pregunta en que momento lo dejo de querer para traicionarlo as . Betzaida se da cuenta que R mulo no est a su lado y llama a su mam y le comenta, su mam trata de justificarlo. Cuando R mulo llega a su casa, se pone a llorar y lo que no sabe es que Betzaida esta escondida observ ndolo. Gladis llega a casa de la Nena y esta le cuenta todo lo que le paso con Doroteo y con Aristigueta. Jerson al ver a Tatianita la piropea y lo que no saben los dos, es que son hijos del mismo padre. Doroteo que esta desayunando con Aristigueta le cuenta lo que le est pasando con la Nena, sin saber que esa conquista que tiene es el mismo Aristigueta. Dileidi lleva a Yeniluz al trabajo y obtiene el puesto de recepcionista. Matilde al llegar al trabajo con Gonzalo se da cuenta de la forma en cambia de personalidad. Matilde le avisa a Monchito que deben estar con cautela porque Gonzalo sospecha de el. En el estacionamiento del edificio la Nena, Tatianita y Pascuita est n conversando sobre los esfuerzo que est realizando Pascuita por quedar embarazada y estas le dan cierto consejos. Tatiana convence a La Nena para que le preste el carro que le acaba de regalar Aristigueta. La Nena no se lo quiere prestar porque ella no quiere recibir ese auto pero es convencida por Tatianita y se lo presta. Doroteo esta en la parte de abajo del edificio porque le va a pedir perd n porque cree que La Nena est ofendida, pero ve salir a Tatiana con el carro nuevo, que supuestamente La Nena le dijo que era de la vecina corroborando as la mentira y la conquista millonaria que tiene ella.

programme.desc: Dileidi trata de despedirse de Lu s Fernando con un beso en la mejilla pero el no se resiste y voltea un poco la cara para que sea en la boca; Dileidi le reclama. En casa de Gladis, Gabito la invita a salir, pero Gladis se niega, Dileidi llega a la casa y Aureliano le asoma un peque o reclamo pero Dileidi tambi n se molesta y le recuerda que ellos son amigos. Gladis le pregunta qui n la llevo hasta la casa y Dileidi miente. Por otro lado Santiago flirtrea con Egle en su casa y llega Lu s Fernando y los encuentra muy contento preguntando cual es el chiste; ellos disimulan pero los interrumpe Mar a Gracia d ndole la bienvenida a Lu s Fernando y llev ndoselo para el cuarto. Jerson que se encuentra en la cocina con Gladis, le comenta que se siente muy bien por el trabajo de vigilante que ahora tiene, y le comenta que le gustar a que su pap lo viera porque puede sentirse orgulloso de el vi ndolo vestido de uniforme; Gladis se enoja por ese comentario porque Jerson sabe que su pap los abandono cuando supo que ella estaba embarazada. Jerson insiste y le pregunta si sabe en donde localizarlo, Gladis lo niega. Aristigueta se encuentra reunido con Marco Aurelio discutiendo el proyecto de la urbanizaci n y son interrumpidos por una llamada que le hicieron a Aristigueta sobre el pedido de flores. Marco Aurelio se asombra por la hora de ese pedido pero Aristigueta le responde que es el amor. La Nena est muy nerviosa porque no sabe quien est tocando el timbre porque puede ser Aristigueta o Doroteo. Cuando abre se da cuenta que es Doroteo y lo recibe muy bien. La Nena nota que Doroteo est extra o y este le reclama sobre el supuesto mercadito que le regalaron las amigas, porque Jerson le cont a Doroteo que ese mercadito se lo llevaron en un carrazo y un chofer hasta su casa, y el lo nico que quiere saber si es verdad que ella tiene una conquista millonaria. La Nena se muestra molesta por ese reclamo y porque la esta tildando de mentirosa y discuten, pero en ese momento el timbre suena y es una persona que por cierto le pide ayuda a Doroteo para poder llevar a la casa muchos ramos de flores. Cuando el mensajero se va de la casa Doroteo le reclama por todas flores y se va muy molesto de la casa. La Nena trata de detenerlo pero sin xito. Tatiana llega en ese momento y se muestra muy alegre por todos esos ramos. Gabito y Aureliano llegan a la bodega muy mal por el rechazo que obtuvieron tanto de Gladis como de Dileidi respectivamente; All son recibidos por Remedio con una gran comida y mucho cari o. Dileidi que esta con Yeniluz en su cuarto le propone que trabaje con ella en la empresa, y le cuenta adem s que qui n la llevo para su casa fue Lu s Fernando. Mientras que en casa de Egle, Lu s Fernando le est contando todo lo que le pasa con Dileidi, pero Santiago no le esta poniendo atenci n alguna, ya que lo que est pendiente es de Egle que est en el sofa y viceversa, Egle hace que est leyendo pero lo que est es pendiente de Santiago. Egle se despide porque supuestamente se va a dormir y Santiago tambi n lo hace muy apresuradamente dejando a Lu s Fernando sin poder contar todo lo sucedido. R mulo dormido sue a con varias escena y en todas ellas aparecen dici ndolo que no lo saben o puede ser. R mulo se despierta exaltado y piensa que todo est clarisimo; Egle lo traicion , se esta acostando con otro y par ndose y llegando a la casa de Egle despertando a todos. R mulo le reclama a Egle y ella est muy confusa porque no sabe de lo que le est hablando el. R mulo sigue habl ndole y le dice pregunta en que momento lo dejo de querer para traicionarlo as . Betzaida se da cuenta que R mulo no est a su lado y llama a su mam y le comenta, su mam trata de justificarlo. Cuando R mulo llega a su casa, se pone a llorar y lo que no sabe es que Betzaida esta escondida observ ndolo. Gladis llega a casa de la Nena y esta le cuenta todo lo que le paso con Doroteo y con Aristigueta. Jerson al ver a Tatianita la piropea y lo que no saben los dos, es que son hijos del mismo padre. Doroteo que esta desayunando con Aristigueta le cuenta lo que le est pasando con la Nena, sin saber que esa conquista que tiene es el mismo Aristigueta. Dileidi lleva a Yeniluz al trabajo y obtiene el puesto de recepcionista. Matilde al llegar al trabajo con Gonzalo se da cuenta de la forma en cambia de personalidad. Matilde le avisa a Monchito que deben estar con cautela porque Gonzalo sospecha de el. En el estacionamiento del edificio la Nena, Tatianita y Pascuita est n conversando sobre los esfuerzo que est realizando Pascuita por quedar embarazada y estas le dan cierto consejos. Tatiana convence a La Nena para que le preste el carro que le acaba de regalar Aristigueta. La Nena no se lo quiere prestar porque ella no quiere recibir ese auto pero es convencida por Tatianita y se lo presta. Doroteo esta en la parte de abajo del edificio porque le va a pedir perd n porque cree que La Nena est ofendida, pero ve salir a Tatiana con el carro nuevo, que supuestamente La Nena le dijo que era de la vecina corroborando as la mentira y la conquista millonaria que tiene ella.

programme.desc: Doroteo dice saber todo la verdad a la Nena. Ella se pone nerviosa pero el le dice que vio a Tatianita en el carro y que el ya sabe que qui n tiene la conquista millonaria no es ella sino su hija Tatianita. Mientras que Tatianita llega a la oficina de Lu s Fernando y le quiere mostrar el carro. Lu s Fernando le dice que se alegra mucho por ella y que se lo merec a despu s de lo que ha pasado. Tatianita le pide que le de un gran abrazo, vi ndolo Dileidi. Yeniluz recibe las ltimas instrucciones sobre el cargo que est ocupando en la empresa, la acompa a Dileidi para ense arla y ayudarla y aprovechan y conversan sobre Lu s Fernando, pero llega Aureliano con mucha alegr a felicitando a Yeniluz y d ndole un gran abrazo y dici ndole indirectas a Dileidi pero lo que no sabe Aureliano es que Dileidi en realidad lo que desea es un gran abrazo de el para restreg rselo a Lu s Fernando y a su catirita. Lu s Fernando se encuentra reunido con Matilde y Monchito pero lo que no sabe el, es que mientras est dando su opiniones, Matilde y Monchito esta mir ndose en forma enamorada y pensando cada uno en el otro y no poni ndole atenci n. Felicita entra a la reuni n para hablar con Monchito y recibe un halago de Lu s Fernando sobre su silueta, eso bast para que Felicita se contentar mucho y le diera un abrazo de agradecimiento; cuando sucede ese abrazo entra Dileidi al sal n y vuelve a ver a Lu s Fernando abrazado con otra catirita. Santiago quiere hablar con Egle que la tiene cerca pero no haya la manera de hacerlo, pero Egle lo llama por tel fono y el se contenta much simo, Egle le pide que no se dirija a ella en todo el d a y le cuenta que R mulo est muy extra o y sospechoso. Cuando est n hablando llega R mulo y se da cuenta de que est n hablando, imaginando situaciones como el golpear a Santiago por salir con su mujer. Yeniluz llama a Dileidi para que se de cuenta de que est llegando Mar a Gracia a la empresa y expresamente se dirige a Lu s Fernando y le da otro abrazo, claro d ndose cuenta Dileidi y por otro lado recibiendo las indirectas de Aureliano sobre ser panas. Aristigueta va a el edificio en donde vive la Nena y se encuentra con Jerson trabajando como vigilante. Aristigueta es muy bien tratado por Jerson y lo deja pasar. Pero lo que no saben los dos es que son padre e hijo. Aristigueta toca la puerta de la casa de La Nena para que la se ora de servicio le abra y as poder entregar el sobre pero Gladis estaba disfrutando de la ba era y no se molest en abrir la puerta. Aristigueta no le quedo otro remedio que lanzarle el sobre por debajo de la puerta e irse, siendo otra vez tratado muy bien por Jerson y este recibi de parte de Aristigueta una muy buena propina. Betzaida y R mulo se marchan de la oficina no sin antes despedirse de Egle. Santiago quiere decir a gritos que est enamorado de Egle. Y Lu s Fernando trata de convencer a Dileidi para que le de un abraso de feliz a o. Matilde se despide de Ernesto que su pap lo va a pasar buscando por el edificio. Pero para sorpresa de Matilde a medianoche se encuentra a Ernesto muy triste en el edificio y llorando porque su pap una vez m s no lo fue a buscar. Matilde trata de consolarlo. Gladis con toda su familia ya est n celebrando el treinta y uno de diciembre y Gladis se encuentra muy feliz por los logros que han obtenido sus hijos, pero recibe la llamada de Marco Aurelio que la invita a pasarla con el ese d a, siendo rechazado por Gladis porque ella acostumbra a pasarla con sus hijos. Gabito y Aureliano llegan a la casa de Gabito muy contentos pero se aparece Remedio, y Gladis de mala gana la acepta en su casa. Dileidi pensando en todo lo que le paso con Lu s Fernando y sus catiritas decide probar con Aureliano y le pide un abrazo de Fin de a o pero muy amorosamente. Por otro lado en casa de Pascuita la Nena y Tatianita llegan para celebrar el feliz a o pero m s atr s se presenta Aristigueta. Al cabo rato tocan la puerta y es Doroteo muy alegre pero es parado en la puerta por La Nena y se lo lleva de all a casa de Matilde sin que se de cuenta Doroteo. programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: Amor Secreto

Carlos Ernesto presiona Alejandra para que confiese que fue ella quien envío las fotos a los medios de comunicación. Alejandra está muy descontenta con la suspensión laboral de Irene. Trinidad termina internada en terapia intensiva.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: La situación de Trinidad empeora, tiene comprometidos los riñones y es posible la idea de realizar un trasplante. Irene se entera quien provoco todo fue Jimena, mamá de Leonardo. Irene aún sigue sintiéndose culpable de lo que le pasó a la madre y más aún cuando se entera quien provoco su inestabilidad. Y está dispuesta a sacrificar su matrimonio por la libertad de su hermana.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo e Irene tienen una conversación muy seria después de lo que pasó en la empresa. Esa noche, tras regresar de la clínica, donde Irene cuidó a su madre todo el día, Agustina increpa a Leonardo y le recrimina no haberle avisado que no vendría a cenar y que tampoco se haya preocupado por sus hijos. Ya en su dormitorio, Leonardo e Irene hacen el amor por primera vez.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Asesinan a dos reclusas en la cárcel donde está Virginia. Jimena se entera de esto y va a la cárcel, junto con Carlos Ernesto, ella termina confesando que recibió una llamada de alguien que ofrecía asesinar a Virginia. Felipe va a la casa de los Ferrándiz para avisarle a Irene de lo sucedido en la cárcel y Agustina sorprende a Felipe y a Irene abrazándose.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo visita a Trinidad en la clínica. Ella desconfía de las intenciones de Leonardo y de la familia Ferrándiz en general. Le asegura que su hija, Virginia, es inocente. Leonardo le garantiza que se equivoca, que la situación de Virginia es muy incómoda para todos. Irene, junto con Felipe, van a visitar a Jimena y a Carlos Ernesto.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene vuelve a la empresa y se confronta nuevamente con Alejandra, quien no quiere que esta pise la empresa. Leonardo le pide a Irene que no lo vaya a visitar por unos días, pero se vuelve un problema secundario, cuando descubren que doña Jimena desapareció. Irene tiene una idea eficaz para encontrarla, y cuando esto ocurre, Leonardo va en busca de su mamá, quien fue lastimada por Maruja.

programme.title: Amor Secreto

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

Descubriendo una red de delitos, engaños y corrupción que abarca ambos condados, Alden se encuentra atrapado en una red criminal sin refuerzos, sin placa, y la dueña de un restaurante local, Maddie (Patricia Richardson, Home Improvement, The West Wing) como su única aliada. Incapaz de dejar de sospechar de un jefe criminal local, Alden sigue su instinto y empieza a investigar el caso en vez de mantener su palabra a la metódica Porter. Siguiendo una pista, cruza la línea del condado, creando hostilidad entre ambos. Pero cuando otro abogado aparece muerto bajo circunstancias misteriosas, la investigación da un giro inesperado. Ambos Sheriffs se dan cuenta de que deben dejar de lado sus diferencias y trabajar juntos para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Ana María González, coach fitness apasionada por ayudar a las personas a encontrar constancia y propósito en el movimiento. Desde consejos prácticos para tonificar el cuerpo, mejorar la postura o fortalecer el core, hasta herramientas para establecer objetivos realistas y sostenibles, nos comparte cómo pequeños hábitos pueden transformar nuestra salud física y mental. Ana nos adentra en el mundo del indoor cycling, una disciplina de alta intensidad que ha ganado popularidad por su impacto positivo en la salud y su capacidad de conectar con la música y la motivación colectiva. Además, hablamos sobre nuevas tendencias como el Barré y el Hyrox, la importancia de romper estereotipos de género en el fitness y cómo el ejercicio puede convertirse en una experiencia 360 que va más allá del cuerpo, impulsando comunidad, autoconocimiento y bienestar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: En este episodio nuestra invitada es Yadira Pérez, actriz nominada al Ariel y a Las Diosas de Plata por su participación en “SUJO”, película que fue seleccionada para representar a México en los Premios Oscar y Goya 2025. Yadira comparte cómo el teatro se convirtió en su gran escuela de vida, su manera de construir personajes inspirados en mujeres reales y la pasión que siente cada vez que pisa un escenario o un set de cine. Además, reflexiona sobre la conexión entre actores y directores, los retos de reconocerse a sí misma como artista y el papel del cuerpo como vehículo de emociones. Un episodio que celebra el amor al arte dramático, la fuerza de las historias y el camino de una actriz que sigue conquistando con su entrega y sensibilidad.
